# v0.11

Released 2026-11-03.

## Highlights

- The snap moves to strict confinement with the wine user folders kept private.
- Bluetooth is documented as non-functional on Wine 11.21 at this point.
- `hardware-observe` and `process-control` plugs dropped; the `bluez` plug is enabled.
